description: Judged queries for the search benchmark (PROD-10). Each case names a command planted in the generated corpus and the query a user would realistically type to find it. Keep these stable: changing a case invalidates comparison with earlier runs.

cases.name: exact-old-command
cases.intent: The oldest planted command, typed out in full. This is the case that used to vanish behind the candidate window.

cases.name: partial-phrase
cases.intent: A contiguous fragment of a long command.

cases.name: reordered-words
cases.intent: Tokens typed in a different order from the command.

cases.name: short-query
cases.intent: A short token that matches many commands; the planted one must still be among the eligible matches.

cases.name: directory-specific
cases.intent: A task a user associates with one project directory.

cases.name: failed-command
cases.intent: A command that failed; recall must not drop it.

cases.name: multiline-command
cases.expect:
for host in web01 web02 web03
do
  ssh $host 'systemctl status suvadu'
done
cases.intent: A multiline command recorded as one entry.

cases.name: unicode-command
cases.expect: git commit -m 'café latte parser: handle Émile'
cases.intent: Non-ASCII text, which SQLite's LIKE cannot case-fold.

cases.name: unicode-case-folded
cases.expect: git commit -m 'café latte parser: handle Émile'
cases.intent: Non-ASCII differing only by case from the stored command.

cases.name: agent-command
cases.intent: Run by an agent, so hidden from default recall but findable when agents are shown.
